description: User-facing specs for cymatic params UI, Faraway wardrobe selection, cymatic pattern browser, and rhythm integration. Spec only — no widget writes.

cymatic_params_ui.goal: User-adjustable cymatic parameters panel that drives cymatic PBR preview without regenerating textures.

widget_spec.host: Hosted in wardrobe / lookdev details panel or standalone Cymatics Lab panel; not on battle HUD (single-writer rule per AGENTS.md).

parameters.label: Pattern
parameters.binding: Selects which T_Cymatic_<Variant>_* texture set is previewed. Swaps all 9 PBR slots atomically.
parameters.persistence: Editor preview only; not saved to narrative record. Future: save as cosmetic preference via wardrobe subsystem.

parameters.label: Frame
parameters.binding: Selects numbered frame suffix .N on PNGs (e.g., T_Cymatic_GlitterIridescent_BaseColor.7.png). Single-frame variants lock to 0.
parameters.note: Variants with 81 PNGs = 9 maps x 9 frames; 153 PNGs = 9 maps x 17 frames; 9 PNGs = single frame.

parameters.label: Tiling
parameters.binding: Scalar parameter on preview MI (TexCoord tiling). No texture reimport.
parameters.preview_effect: Controls repetition density of cymatic standing-wave pattern.

parameters.label: Intensity
parameters.binding: Lerps Height/Emissive contribution in preview MI. 0 = flat, 1 = full displacement/emission.

parameters.label: Iridescence
parameters.binding: Scales Iridescence map contribution in preview MI.
parameters.note: Iridescence is a cymatic-specific map not present in FarawayMother suites.

parameters.label: Polish
parameters.binding: Additive bias on Roughness map sample before MI roughness input.
parameters.display: Label 'Polish' inversely maps: higher polish = lower roughness.

preview_surface.description: Preview MI on a flat plane or sphere primitive in the panel; swaps textures per variant selection.
preview_surface.material: Reuse existing cymatic master MI (proposed: MI_Cymatic_Preview under Content/Melodia/Materials/Cymatics/ — to be authored). Must support BaseColor/N/ORM/Height/Roughness/Metallic/Emissive/Opacity/Iridescence slots.
preview_surface.fallback: If master MI not yet authored, preview falls back to BaseColor-only quad using T_ContactSheet_* as thumbnail grid.

constraints: Spec only — no WBP writes in this deliverable.
Must not create a second HUD writer; preview panel is separate from WBP_MelodiaRhythmHighway.
All params are preview scalars; no hython/COPs regeneration from UI in v1.
Variant list is data-driven from Saved/Audit/copernicus_cymatic/ folder scan, not hardcoded enum.

faraway_wardrobe_selection.goal: Faraway Mother outfit selection integrated with existing wardrobe authority (MelodiaWardrobeSubsystem).

widget_spec.integration: Calls UMelodiaWardrobeSubsystem::EquipCosmetic / UnequipSlot; never writes save record directly. Mirrors MelodiaNarrativeTypes.h EMelodiaWardrobeSlot.

outfit_mapping.notes: Hero gown. Body slot. Sheen map drives fabric sheen param on wardrobe MI.
Shirt slot (V2 split-garment). Brocade detail via ORM + Height.
Shawl slot. Velvet pile via Sheen + Roughness.
HairCharm slot. Alpha/Mask for lace cutout. Requires opacity-masked MI.
Accessories slot. Nacre iridescence via Sheen.

Trail slot repurposed for wood/cradle accent, or future Boots/Trail prop. Wood grain via Height + Roughness. Alternative: map to world prop, not wardrobe, if Trail semantics mismatch — decision deferred to wardrobe catalog review.

selection_flow.browse: Grid of 6 Faraway suite cards with BC thumbnail + rarity badge. Data source: Content/Textures/FarawayMother_Suites/ T_FarawayMother_*_BC.png.
selection_flow.preview: 3D mannequin (Melusina skeletal mesh) with UMelodiaWardrobeComponent; equip is live preview, not committed until Confirm.
selection_flow.equip: Confirm calls WardrobeSubsystem.TryEquip(CosmeticId) — respects ownership (Gacha subsystem) and slot exclusivity. Emits FMelodiaWardrobeChanged delegate.
selection_flow.ownership_gate: If cosmetic not owned, card shows Locked + Gacha pull CTA (delegates to MelodiaWardrobeGachaSubsystem). No direct grant.
selection_flow.save: Equipped map persists via FMelodiaNarrativeRecord additive v3 fields (wardrobe subsystem already handles save/load). No new save schema.

constraints: Must not invent slots — only 10 values in EMelodiaWardrobeSlot are valid.
CosmeticDefinitions to be authored as DataAssets wrapping these texture sets; this spec proposes IDs only.
ContactSheet FarawayMother_ContactSheet.png in Saved/Audit/ can serve as overview thumbnail until per-suite cards are ready.

cymatic_pattern_browser.goal: Browse 21 cymatic patterns as a visual pattern library for selection, comparison, and assignment.

widget_spec.relation_to_params_ui: Browser and Params Panel share selected variant state; browser is grid navigation, panel is detail tuning.

data_source.thumbnails: BaseColor PNGs as grid tiles; Height as hover overlay option
data_source.contact_sheet_fallback: Content/EnvSandbox/Textures/_ContactSheets/T_ContactSheet_Flipbook.uasset and 6 other contact sheets for composite overview when per-variant textures not yet imported as UE assets.
data_source.import_status: Cymatic PNGs currently live under Saved/Audit/copernicus_cymatic/ (not yet under Content/). Browser spec assumes future import to Content/Textures/Cymatics/<Variant>/ or streaming via contact sheets until import.

layout.grid: 21 cards, 3-4 columns, scrollable. Each card: BaseColor thumbnail, variant name, badge (Single / Flipbook 9f / Flipbook 17f), map-count indicator (9 maps).

interactions.result: Selects variant; updates WBP_CymaticParamsPanel and preview surface.
Assigns selected cymatic pattern to target binding (see rhythm_integration.target_bindings).
Shows tooltip: variant name, frame count, map list (9), source path.
Optional 2-up comparison mode (two selected cards side-by-side on preview plane).

empty_states.no_import: If Content/Textures/Cymatics/ not yet populated, browser renders from Saved/Audit PNGs via contact sheets with banner: 'Preview from audit assets — import pending'.
empty_states.single_vs_flipbook: Flipbook variants show frame scrubber; single-frame variants show static badge.

faraway_pattern_browser.goal: Browse Faraway Mother fabric patterns (6 suites) for wardrobe selection and material reference.

widget_spec.proposed_widget: WBP_FarawayPatternBrowser (CommonActivatableWidget) or integrated tab within WBP_FarawayWardrobePanel
widget_spec.recommendation: Implement as tab/filter within FarawayWardrobePanel to avoid duplicate wardrobe entry points. Separate widget only if material-reference use case (lookdev) needs standalone access.

data_source.detail_maps: Per-suite: BC, N, ORM, AO, H, M, R, Sheen, (Alpha, Mask where present)

layout.grid: 6 cards (one per suite), 2-3 columns. Each card: BC swatch, suite display name, slot badge (Body/Shirt/Shawl/etc), rarity, map chips (BC N ORM AO H M R Sheen).
layout.detail_view: On select: large BC preview, map toggles (cycle through N/ORM/H/Sheen overlays), slot + cosmetic ID, Equip button (delegates to wardrobe subsystem).

interactions.result: Selects suite; shows detail + map toggles.
Cycles detail preview through BC → N → ORM → H → Sheen for material inspection.

rhythm_integration.goal: Connect cymatic + Faraway pattern selection to the existing rhythm combat loop without creating a second combat authority.
rhythm_integration.authority_note: Rhythm rides on top of JRPG command input (AGENTS.md Core Vision). UMelodiaRhythmCombatSubsystem is the rhythm authority; MelodiaWardrobeSubsystem is the wardrobe authority. New UI does not own combat timing.

rhythm_system.existing_evidence: owner PIE 2026-08-13: Melusina unique → highway (clunky) → damage → next turn on skill finish (AGENTS.md P0 authority).

integration_points.description: Cymatic interference pattern drives rhythm grade thresholds or highway skin.
integration_points.spec: Selected cymatic variant maps to a highway visual theme (e.g., VoronoiSacredGeometry → tessellated note trail, GlitterIridescent → holographic trail). No gameplay stat change in v1; purely presentation. Future: cymatic intensity → timing window modifier behind feature flag.
integration_points.data: 21 cymatic variants → 21 highway skins (1:1) or grouped by 3 categories → 3 skins (MVP). Spec recommends 3-category MVP (Sacred Geometry / Glitter / Organic) to limit art scope.
integration_points.guardrail: Damage scalar sequencing must be verified before any timing-window tuning (AGENTS.md item 4: damage notify may fire ~2.5s before scalar latches). No A/B balance numbers from UI until that sequencing is proven.

integration_points.description: Cymatic standing-wave density hints at beatmap density (authoring-time, not runtime).
integration_points.spec: At beatmap authoring (beatmap_author lane), cymatic pattern's spatial frequency suggests note density / hand assignment. Runtime: beatmap remains authored data; cymatic selection does not procedurally generate beatmaps in v1.
integration_points.status: Authoring assist only; no runtime procedural beatmap generation.

integration_points.description: Equipped Faraway outfit influences rhythm highway avatar / VFX tint (presentation only).
integration_points.spec: Equipped Faraway cosmetic (e.g., Gown_CelestialSilkJacquard) tints highway avatar or note hit VFX via wardrobe MI params forwarded to rhythm HUD. No combat stat change in v1 (wardrobe gameplay hook is a separate P0 gate: wardrobe_gameplay_hook).
integration_points.reading: WBP_MelodiaRhythmHighway reads equipped cosmetics via MelodiaWardrobeSubsystem on battle entry; updates material instance params.
integration_points.guardrail: Wardrobe gameplay hook (P0 gate) is the only path for outfit → stat effects. UI spec does not grant stats.

integration_points.description: Unified assign flow from either browser to rhythm target.
steps: User browses cymatic or Faraway pattern in respective browser.
Clicks Assign → picker: 'Highway Skin' | 'Wardrobe Equip' | 'Preview Only'.
Highway Skin: stores preference (local config, not save record) and applies on next battle entry.
Preview Only: updates params panel preview, no persistence.

persistence.cymatic_highway_skin: Local user preference (GameUserSettings or per-profile config). Not narrative save.

ui_wiring_summary.battle_hud_single_writer: WBP_MelodiaRhythmHighway remains the sole battle HUD writer (P0 gate hud_single_writer). Cymatic/Faraway panels are out-of-battle (wardrobe / lab) and never write to battle HUD surfaces.
ui_wiring_summary.common_ui: All new panels extend CommonActivatableWidget with CommonUI input routing (back stack, focus).
ui_wiring_summary.input: Gamepad/keyboard legends via CommonUI; no custom input routing.

non_goals_v1: Procedural beatmap generation from cymatic audio analysis.
Cymatic params driving live COPs/hython regeneration.
Wardrobe outfit granting rhythm timing buffs (requires wardrobe_gameplay_hook gate).
Second rhythm combat authority or duplicate damage path.

next_steps: Author WBP_CymaticParamsPanel + WBP_CymaticBrowser (one-editor Monolith pass, after cymatics_present_phase_1).
Author WBP_FarawayWardrobePanel (+ optional WBP_FarawayPatternBrowser tab) via wardrobe_catalog lane.
Import Saved/Audit/copernicus_cymatic/ PNGs to Content/Textures/Cymatics/<Variant>/ and wire preview MI.
Create 6 UMelodiaCosmeticDefinition DataAssets for Faraway suites (Content/Melodia/Wardrobe/Faraway/).
Wire highway skin preference: cymatic category → WBP_MelodiaRhythmHighway material params.

open_questions: Should Cradle_CarvedAlabasterWood map to Trail slot or be a world prop only? Needs catalog review.
Import path for 1665 cymatic PNGs: bulk import to Content/ vs. on-demand streaming from Saved/Audit/ — decide with P0_TASK_LEDGER owner.
Faraway suite rarity values (Legendary/Epic/etc) are proposals; confirm with economy/gacha design.
Highway skin: 21-variant 1:1 vs 3-category MVP — spec recommends 3-category MVP for scope.
